description: A Database for Seismic Retrofit Construction Cost of Concrete and Steel Framed Schools in Iran is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ekin Gultepe, University of Canterbury (canterbury.ac.nz). Seismic retrofitting of existing structures is a key issue in any earthquake-prone region when considering the extensive damage and severe economic loss caused by previous strong ground motions (Nuti and Vanzi, 2003). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (CSV). Its DOI is 10.4231/d3959c774. Keywords: databases , construction cost , earthquake engineering , Iran , seismic retrofit . Published 2013-12-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
